title: Backup Chats messages, gallery
summary: Backup WhatsApp chats & media, export messages, and keep them secure
description:
Backup Chats messages, gallery is a WhatsApp chat backup, export, media viewer and dual WhatsApp Web companion for Android. Save WhatsApp conversations and media, browse exported messages and files, send messages without saving phone numbers, and use a second WhatsApp account through Web Duo.

📥 WhatsApp Chat Backup & Export
Create a private, easy-to-browse copy of your WhatsApp chat history using WhatsApp’s built-in Export Chat feature. Import conversations with messages and media into Backup Chats messages, gallery and keep them available inside the app. Your imported chat can remain accessible even after the original conversation is deleted from WhatsApp.

🔐 Private Chat Vault & App Lock
Protect imported conversations with a passcode or biometric security such as fingerprint, Touch ID or Face ID, where supported by your device. Keep personal conversations, photos, videos and documents behind an additional app-level lock.
Important: this app does not lock or add a passcode to the official WhatsApp application. The lock protects only the conversations and media imported into this app.

💬 Direct WhatsApp Chat — Message Without Saving Number
Use Quick Messages / Direct Chat to start a WhatsApp conversation without saving the recipient’s phone number first. Useful for business inquiries, deliveries, customer support, temporary conversations and one-time messages. View your sent-message history to revisit previous direct messages.

🌐 Web Duo WhatsApp — Two Accounts on One Phone
Connect another WhatsApp account on the same Android phone. Scan the WhatsApp Web / Linked Devices QR code and access the second account through a mobile-responsive web chat interface. Web Duo is designed for dual WhatsApp access, multiple-account messaging and WhatsApp Web on mobile.

⭐ Key Features
• WhatsApp chat backup and export viewer
• Import chat messages and media
• Secure imported chat storage
• Passcode and biometric app lock
• Photos, videos and document viewer
• Direct WhatsApp chat without saving numbers
• Message history
• Persistent imported chat archives
• Web Duo WhatsApp for a second account
• WhatsApp Web QR / Linked Devices access
• Mobile-responsive dual web chats
• Google Drive backup and restore

🌍 Supported WhatsApp Import Languages
English, Russian, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Dutch, Swedish, Portuguese, Italian, Korean, Danish, Canadian English, Indonesian, Swiss German, Malay, Czech, Hong Kong Cantonese, Hebrew, and Arabic (partial).

📌 How WhatsApp Chat Backup Works

1. Open a chat in WhatsApp and choose Export Chat.
2. Include media when required and share the export to this app.
3. Browse your imported messages and media.
4. Protect the archive with passcode or biometric lock.
5. Optionally back up supported data to Google Drive.

Backup Chats messages, gallery is an independent companion utility for managing your own exported WhatsApp conversations. It does not access or modify WhatsApp’s internal database and does not claim to recover messages that were never exported or imported. Web Duo uses WhatsApp Web / Linked Devices access and requires the relevant WhatsApp account and internet connection.

⚠️ Disclaimer
WhatsApp and related names, logos, brands and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Backup Chats messages, gallery is an independent third-party application and is not affiliated with, authorized, endorsed or sponsored by WhatsApp Inc. or Meta Platforms, Inc.

This app does not secure or lock the official WhatsApp app. Passcode, fingerprint, Touch ID or Face ID protection applies only to content imported into this application. WhatsApp chat export and Web Duo functionality depend on features and access provided by WhatsApp.
